<section class="level1" id="tirer-un-échantillon">
<h2 class="h1">Tirer un échantillon</h2>
<section class="level2" id="deux-langages-les-mêmes-données">
<h3 class="h2 anchored" data-anchor-id="deux-langages-les-mêmes-données">Deux langages, les mêmes données</h3>
<details class="definitionbox" open="">
<summary class="pedago-title">Le matériel du chapitre</summary>
<div class="pedago-body">
<ul>
<li><strong>R</strong> 4.3.3 : <code>sampling</code> 2.10 pour <strong>tirer</strong>, <code>survey</code> 4.2.1 pour <strong>estimer</strong> ; on déclare le plan, il en déduit poids, estimations et erreurs-types.</li>
<li><strong>Python</strong> : <code>numpy</code> et <code>pandas</code> pour tout écrire <strong>à la main</strong> ; <code>samplics</code> 0.6.0 refait les calculs de <code>survey</code> (à l’import, cette version avertit qu’elle n’est plus maintenue).</li>
</ul>
</div>
</details>
<details class="examplebox" open="">
<summary class="pedago-title">Charger la population du cours</summary>
<div class="pedago-body">
<div class="sourceCode" id="cb1"><pre class="sourceCode r code-with-copy"><code class="sourceCode r"><span id="cb1-1"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb1-1" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">library</span>(sampling)              <span class="co"># tirer</span></span>
<span id="cb1-2"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb1-2" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">library</span>(survey)                <span class="co"># estimer</span></span>
<span id="cb1-3"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb1-3" tabindex="-1"></a>d <span class="ot">&lt;-</span> <span class="fu">read.csv</span>(<span class="st">"menages.csv"</span>)</span></code><button class="code-copy-button" title="Copier vers le presse-papier"><i class="bi"></i></button></pre></div>
<div class="sourceCode" id="cb2"><pre class="sourceCode python code-with-copy"><code class="sourceCode python"><span id="cb2-1"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb2-1" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="im">import</span> numpy <span class="im">as</span> np, pandas <span class="im">as</span> pd</span>
<span id="cb2-2"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb2-2" tabindex="-1"></a>d <span class="op">=</span> pd.read_csv(<span class="st">"menages.csv"</span>)</span></code><button class="code-copy-button" title="Copier vers le presse-papier"><i class="bi"></i></button></pre></div>
<p>Chaque sortie de ce chapitre est celle de ces programmes, <strong>exécutés</strong> sur <code>menages.csv</code>.</p>
</div>
</details>
</section>
<section class="level2" id="même-graine-deux-échantillons">
<h3 class="h2 anchored" data-anchor-id="même-graine-deux-échantillons">Même graine, deux échantillons</h3>
<details class="examplebox" open="">
<summary class="pedago-title">Tirer 200 ménages parmi 2 000</summary>
<div class="pedago-body">
<div class="sourceCode" id="cb3"><pre class="sourceCode r code-with-copy"><code class="sourceCode r"><span id="cb3-1"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb3-1" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">set.seed</span>(<span class="dv">2026</span>)                 <span class="co"># la graine</span></span>
<span id="cb3-2"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb3-2" tabindex="-1"></a>s <span class="ot">&lt;-</span> <span class="fu">sample</span>(<span class="dv">2000</span>, <span class="dv">200</span>)         <span class="co"># 200 numéros parmi 2 000</span></span>
<span id="cb3-3"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb3-3" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">head</span>(s)</span>
<span id="cb3-4"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb3-4" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">mean</span>(d<span class="sc">$</span>depense[s])</span></code><button class="code-copy-button" title="Copier vers le presse-papier"><i class="bi"></i></button></pre></div>
<pre><code>[1]  733 1657  993  294 1581 1647
[1] 7803</code></pre>
<div class="sourceCode" id="cb5"><pre class="sourceCode python code-with-copy"><code class="sourceCode python"><span id="cb5-1"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb5-1" tabindex="-1"></a>rng <span class="op">=</span> np.random.default_rng(<span class="dv">2026</span>)               <span class="co"># la graine</span></span>
<span id="cb5-2"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb5-2" tabindex="-1"></a>s <span class="op">=</span> rng.choice(<span class="dv">2000</span>, <span class="dv">200</span>, replace<span class="op">=</span><span class="va">False</span>) <span class="op">+</span> <span class="dv">1</span>    <span class="co"># 1 à 2000</span></span>
<span id="cb5-3"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb5-3" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="bu">print</span>(s[:<span class="dv">6</span>], d.depense[d.<span class="bu">id</span>.isin(s)].mean())</span></code><button class="code-copy-button" title="Copier vers le presse-papier"><i class="bi"></i></button></pre></div>
<pre><code>[ 200  769 1747 1821 1560  307] 7843.05</code></pre>
</div>
</details>
<details class="ecobox" open="">
<summary class="pedago-title">Deux générateurs différents</summary>
<div class="pedago-body">
<p>R emploie par défaut le générateur Mersenne-Twister, <code>numpy</code> le générateur PCG64 : la graine <span class="math inline">2026</span> donne deux sondages aléatoires simples <strong>différents</strong>, de moyennes <span class="math inline">7\,803</span> et <span class="math inline">7\,843{,}05</span> dh. Python retrouve l’échantillon fil rouge du chapitre 3 ; R en tire un autre, tout aussi aléatoire.</p>
</div>
</details>
</section>
<section class="level2" id="partager-la-liste-pas-la-graine">
<h3 class="h2 anchored" data-anchor-id="partager-la-liste-pas-la-graine">Partager la liste, pas la graine</h3>
<details class="examplebox" open="">
<summary class="pedago-title">Trois échantillons définis sans hasard</summary>
<div class="pedago-body">
<div class="sourceCode" id="cb7"><pre class="sourceCode r code-with-copy"><code class="sourceCode r"><span id="cb7-1"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb7-1" tabindex="-1"></a>ids <span class="ot">&lt;-</span> <span class="fu">read.csv</span>(<span class="st">"data/echantillon_fil_rouge.csv"</span>)<span class="sc">$</span>id</span>
<span id="cb7-2"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb7-2" tabindex="-1"></a>e <span class="ot">&lt;-</span> d[d<span class="sc">$</span>id <span class="sc">%in%</span> ids, ]                  <span class="co"># le fil rouge</span></span>
<span id="cb7-3"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb7-3" tabindex="-1"></a>e9 <span class="ot">&lt;-</span> d[<span class="fu">seq</span>(<span class="dv">9</span>, <span class="dv">2000</span>, <span class="at">by =</span> <span class="dv">10</span>), ]         <span class="co"># systématique, départ 9</span></span>
<span id="cb7-4"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb7-4" tabindex="-1"></a>g5 <span class="ot">&lt;-</span> d[d<span class="sc">$</span>district <span class="sc">%in%</span> <span class="fu">c</span>(<span class="dv">2</span>, <span class="dv">9</span>, <span class="dv">19</span>, <span class="dv">32</span>, <span class="dv">40</span>), ]   <span class="co"># 5 districts</span></span>
<span id="cb7-5"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb7-5" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">c</span>(<span class="fu">mean</span>(e<span class="sc">$</span>depense), <span class="fu">mean</span>(e9<span class="sc">$</span>depense), <span class="fu">nrow</span>(g5))</span></code><button class="code-copy-button" title="Copier vers le presse-papier"><i class="bi"></i></button></pre></div>
<pre><code>[1] 7843.05 7922.95  215.00</code></pre>
<div class="sourceCode" id="cb9"><pre class="sourceCode python code-with-copy"><code class="sourceCode python"><span id="cb9-1"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb9-1" tabindex="-1"></a>ids <span class="op">=</span> pd.read_csv(<span class="st">"data/echantillon_fil_rouge.csv"</span>).<span class="bu">id</span></span>
<span id="cb9-2"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb9-2" tabindex="-1"></a>e <span class="op">=</span> d[d.<span class="bu">id</span>.isin(ids)]                      <span class="co"># le fil rouge</span></span>
<span id="cb9-3"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb9-3" tabindex="-1"></a>e9 <span class="op">=</span> d.iloc[<span class="dv">8</span>::<span class="dv">10</span>]                         <span class="co"># départ 9 : rang 8</span></span>
<span id="cb9-4"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb9-4" tabindex="-1"></a>g5 <span class="op">=</span> d[d.district.isin([<span class="dv">2</span>, <span class="dv">9</span>, <span class="dv">19</span>, <span class="dv">32</span>, <span class="dv">40</span>])]</span>
<span id="cb9-5"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb9-5" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="bu">print</span>(e.depense.mean(), e9.depense.mean(), <span class="bu">len</span>(g5))</span></code><button class="code-copy-button" title="Copier vers le presse-papier"><i class="bi"></i></button></pre></div>
<pre><code>7843.05 7922.95 215</code></pre>
</div>
</details>
<details class="intuitionbox" open="">
<summary class="pedago-title">La méthode du chapitre</summary>
<div class="pedago-body">
<p>Pour comparer deux logiciels, il faut le <strong>même échantillon</strong> : on partage la liste des unités tirées, pas la graine. Ces trois échantillons des chapitres 3, 8 et 9 servent partout.</p>
</div>
</details>
</section>
<section class="level2" id="strates-et-grappes-avec-sampling">
<h3 class="h2 anchored" data-anchor-id="strates-et-grappes-avec-sampling">Strates et grappes avec sampling</h3>
<details class="examplebox" open="">
<summary class="pedago-title">Les fonctions strata et cluster</summary>
<div class="pedago-body">
<div class="sourceCode" id="cb11"><pre class="sourceCode r code-with-copy"><code class="sourceCode r"><span id="cb11-1"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb11-1" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">set.seed</span>(<span class="dv">2026</span>)</span>
<span id="cb11-2"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb11-2" tabindex="-1"></a>st <span class="ot">&lt;-</span> sampling<span class="sc">::</span><span class="fu">strata</span>(d, <span class="st">"province"</span>, <span class="at">method =</span> <span class="st">"srswor"</span>,</span>
<span id="cb11-3"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb11-3" tabindex="-1"></a>                       <span class="at">size =</span> <span class="fu">c</span>(<span class="dv">82</span>, <span class="dv">56</span>, <span class="dv">38</span>, <span class="dv">24</span>))</span>
<span id="cb11-4"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb11-4" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">table</span>(<span class="fu">getdata</span>(d, st)<span class="sc">$</span>province)</span>
<span id="cb11-5"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb11-5" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">set.seed</span>(<span class="dv">2026</span>)</span>
<span id="cb11-6"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb11-6" tabindex="-1"></a>cl <span class="ot">&lt;-</span> sampling<span class="sc">::</span><span class="fu">cluster</span>(d, <span class="st">"district"</span>, <span class="at">size =</span> <span class="dv">5</span>,</span>
<span id="cb11-7"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb11-7" tabindex="-1"></a>                        <span class="at">method =</span> <span class="st">"srswor"</span>)</span>
<span id="cb11-8"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb11-8" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">unique</span>(cl<span class="sc">$</span>district)</span></code><button class="code-copy-button" title="Copier vers le presse-papier"><i class="bi"></i></button></pre></div>
<pre><code>    Al Hoceïma        Larache Tanger-Assilah        Tétouan
            24             38             82             56
[1] 27 29 33 38 45</code></pre>
</div>
</details>
<details class="definitionbox" open="">
<summary class="pedago-title">Ce que contiennent les résultats, et en Python</summary>
<div class="pedago-body">
<p><code>st</code> donne la strate et la probabilité d’inclusion (colonne <code>Prob</code> : <span class="math inline">0{,}1</span>) des ménages tirés ; <code>cl</code>, les <span class="math inline">156</span> ménages des districts tirés. En Python, un générateur neuf de graine <span class="math inline">2026</span> tire les districts <span class="math inline">2</span>, <span class="math inline">9</span>, <span class="math inline">19</span>, <span class="math inline">32</span> et <span class="math inline">40</span> (chapitre 9) ; <code>groupby().sample(frac=0.1)</code> tire <span class="math inline">10\,\%</span> par province.</p>
</div>
</details>
</section>
<section class="level2" id="deux-pièges-de-sampling">
<h3 class="h2 anchored" data-anchor-id="deux-pièges-de-sampling">Deux pièges de sampling</h3>
<details class="examplebox" open="">
<summary class="pedago-title">Une fonction masquée</summary>
<div class="pedago-body">
<div class="sourceCode" id="cb13"><pre class="sourceCode r code-with-copy"><code class="sourceCode r"><span id="cb13-1"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb13-1" tabindex="-1"></a>r1 <span class="ot">&lt;-</span> <span class="fu">try</span>(<span class="fu">strata</span>(d, <span class="st">"province"</span>, <span class="at">size =</span> <span class="fu">c</span>(<span class="dv">82</span>, <span class="dv">56</span>, <span class="dv">38</span>, <span class="dv">24</span>)))</span></code><button class="code-copy-button" title="Copier vers le presse-papier"><i class="bi"></i></button></pre></div>
<pre><code>Error in strata(d, "province", size = c(82, 56, 38, 24)) :
  all arguments must be the same length</code></pre>
<p><code>survey</code> charge <code>survival</code>, dont <code>strata</code> et <code>cluster</code> <strong>masquent</strong> celles de <code>sampling</code> (R l’annonce au chargement) : écrire <code>sampling::strata</code>.</p>
</div>
</details>
<details class="ecobox" open="">
<summary class="pedago-title">Des tailles attribuées dans l’ordre du fichier</summary>
<div class="pedago-body">
<div class="sourceCode" id="cb15"><pre class="sourceCode r code-with-copy"><code class="sourceCode r"><span id="cb15-1"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb15-1" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">set.seed</span>(<span class="dv">1</span>); dm <span class="ot">&lt;-</span> d[<span class="fu">sample</span>(<span class="dv">2000</span>), ]     <span class="co"># fichier mélangé</span></span>
<span id="cb15-2"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb15-2" tabindex="-1"></a>st2 <span class="ot">&lt;-</span> sampling<span class="sc">::</span><span class="fu">strata</span>(dm, <span class="st">"province"</span>, <span class="at">method =</span> <span class="st">"srswor"</span>,</span>
<span id="cb15-3"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb15-3" tabindex="-1"></a>                        <span class="at">size =</span> <span class="fu">c</span>(<span class="dv">82</span>, <span class="dv">56</span>, <span class="dv">38</span>, <span class="dv">24</span>))</span>
<span id="cb15-4"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb15-4" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">table</span>(<span class="fu">getdata</span>(dm, st2)<span class="sc">$</span>province)</span></code><button class="code-copy-button" title="Copier vers le presse-papier"><i class="bi"></i></button></pre></div>
<pre><code>    Al Hoceïma        Larache Tanger-Assilah        Tétouan
            56             24             38             82</code></pre>
<p>Les tailles suivent <strong>l’ordre d’apparition</strong> des strates : Al Hoceïma reçoit <span class="math inline">56</span> ménages, sans message. Trier d’abord par strate.</p>
</div>
</details>
</section>
</section>
<section class="level1" id="le-sondage-aléatoire-simple-sous-survey">
<h2 class="h1">Le sondage aléatoire simple sous survey</h2>
<section class="level2" id="déclarer-le-plan">
<h3 class="h2 anchored" data-anchor-id="déclarer-le-plan">Déclarer le plan</h3>
<details class="definitionbox" open="">
<summary class="pedago-title">La fonction svydesign</summary>
<div class="pedago-body">
<ul>
<li><code>ids</code> : les unités tirées au premier degré ; <code>~1</code> : les ménages eux-mêmes, sans grappes.</li>
<li><code>fpc</code> : la taille de la population <span class="math inline">N</span>, ou le taux <span class="math inline">f</span>. <code>survey</code> en déduit les poids <span class="math inline">d_k = N/n</span> et le facteur <span class="math inline">1 - f</span>.</li>
<li><code>strata</code>, <code>weights</code> ou <code>probs</code> : les strates, les poids <span class="math inline">d_k</span> ou les <span class="math inline">\pi_k</span>, quand il y en a.</li>
<li><code>data</code> : le fichier des <strong>seules unités tirées</strong>.</li>
</ul>
</div>
</details>
<details class="examplebox" open="">
<summary class="pedago-title">Le fil rouge</summary>
<div class="pedago-body">
<div class="sourceCode" id="cb17"><pre class="sourceCode r code-with-copy"><code class="sourceCode r"><span id="cb17-1"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb17-1" tabindex="-1"></a>e<span class="sc">$</span>N <span class="ot">&lt;-</span> <span class="dv">2000</span>                    <span class="co"># taille de la population</span></span>
<span id="cb17-2"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb17-2" tabindex="-1"></a>p <span class="ot">&lt;-</span> <span class="fu">svydesign</span>(<span class="at">ids =</span> <span class="sc">~</span><span class="dv">1</span>, <span class="at">fpc =</span> <span class="sc">~</span>N, <span class="at">data =</span> e)</span>
<span id="cb17-3"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb17-3" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">unique</span>(<span class="fu">weights</span>(p))             <span class="co"># d_k = N / n</span></span>
<span id="cb17-4"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb17-4" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">degf</span>(p)                        <span class="co"># n - 1</span></span></code><button class="code-copy-button" title="Copier vers le presse-papier"><i class="bi"></i></button></pre></div>
<pre><code>[1] 10
[1] 199</code></pre>
<p>Chaque ménage tiré en représente <span class="math inline">10</span> (chapitre 3) ; la variance sera estimée avec <span class="math inline">n - 1 = 199</span> degrés de liberté.</p>
</div>
</details>
</section>
<section class="level2" id="moyenne-total-proportion">
<h3 class="h2 anchored" data-anchor-id="moyenne-total-proportion">Moyenne, total, proportion</h3>
<details class="examplebox" open="">
<summary class="pedago-title">Les fonctions svymean et svytotal</summary>
<div class="pedago-body">
<div class="sourceCode" id="cb19"><pre class="sourceCode r code-with-copy"><code class="sourceCode r"><span id="cb19-1"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb19-1" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">svymean</span>(<span class="sc">~</span>depense, p)</span>
<span id="cb19-2"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb19-2" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">svytotal</span>(<span class="sc">~</span>depense, p)</span>
<span id="cb19-3"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb19-3" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">svymean</span>(<span class="sc">~</span>internet, p)</span></code><button class="code-copy-button" title="Copier vers le presse-papier"><i class="bi"></i></button></pre></div>
<pre><code>        mean     SE
depense 7843 256.87
           total     SE
depense 15686100 513736
         mean     SE
internet 0.67 0.0316</code></pre>
</div>
</details>
<details class="intuitionbox" open="">
<summary class="pedago-title">Les formules des chapitres 3 et 4</summary>
<div class="pedago-body">
<ul>
<li><span class="math inline">\sqrt{0{,}9 \times 3\,829{,}16^2/200} = 256{,}87</span> : c’est <span class="math inline">\sqrt{(1-f)\,s^2/n}</span>. R arrondit l’affichage de la moyenne : <code>coef()</code> donne <span class="math inline">7\,843{,}05</span>.</li>
<li>Total : <span class="math inline">2\,000 \times 7\,843{,}05 = 15\,686\,100</span> dh, d’erreur-type <span class="math inline">2\,000 \times 256{,}87 = 513\,736</span>.</li>
<li>Proportion : <span class="math inline">\sqrt{0{,}9 \times 0{,}67 \times 0{,}33/199} = 0{,}0316</span>.</li>
</ul>
</div>
</details>
</section>
<section class="level2" id="lintervalle-de-confiance">
<h3 class="h2 anchored" data-anchor-id="lintervalle-de-confiance">L’intervalle de confiance</h3>
<details class="examplebox" open="">
<summary class="pedago-title">confint, avec ou sans degrés de liberté</summary>
<div class="pedago-body">
<div class="sourceCode" id="cb21"><pre class="sourceCode r code-with-copy"><code class="sourceCode r"><span id="cb21-1"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb21-1" tabindex="-1"></a>m <span class="ot">&lt;-</span> <span class="fu">svymean</span>(<span class="sc">~</span>depense, p)</span>
<span id="cb21-2"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb21-2" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">confint</span>(m)                     <span class="co"># loi normale : 1,96</span></span>
<span id="cb21-3"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb21-3" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">confint</span>(m, <span class="at">df =</span> <span class="fu">degf</span>(p))       <span class="co"># loi de Student : 199 ddl</span></span>
<span id="cb21-4"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb21-4" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">cv</span>(m)                          <span class="co"># SE / moyenne</span></span></code><button class="code-copy-button" title="Copier vers le presse-papier"><i class="bi"></i></button></pre></div>
<pre><code>           2.5 %   97.5 %
depense 7339.598 8346.502
           2.5 %   97.5 %
depense 7336.518 8349.582
           depense
depense 0.03275101</code></pre>
</div>
</details>
<details class="intuitionbox" open="">
<summary class="pedago-title">Normale ou Student</summary>
<div class="pedago-body">
<p>Par défaut, <code>confint</code> prend <span class="math inline">1{,}96</span> : c’est l’intervalle <span class="math inline">[7\,339{,}6\,;8\,346{,}5]</span> du chapitre 3, de coefficient de variation <span class="math inline">3{,}28\,\%</span>. Avec <code>df = degf(p)</code>, il prend <span class="math inline">t = 1{,}972</span>, quantile de la loi de Student à <span class="math inline">199</span> degrés de liberté (Statistique inférentielle, chapitre 4). Ici l’écart est négligeable ; avec cinq grappes, il ne le sera plus.</p>
</div>
</details>
</section>
<section class="level2" id="le-même-calcul-en-python">
<h3 class="h2 anchored" data-anchor-id="le-même-calcul-en-python">Le même calcul en Python</h3>
<details class="examplebox" open="">
<summary class="pedago-title">À la main, avec numpy et pandas</summary>
<div class="pedago-body">
<div class="sourceCode" id="cb23"><pre class="sourceCode python code-with-copy"><code class="sourceCode python"><span id="cb23-1"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb23-1" tabindex="-1"></a>n, N <span class="op">=</span> <span class="bu">len</span>(e), <span class="dv">2000</span></span>
<span id="cb23-2"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb23-2" tabindex="-1"></a>ybar, s <span class="op">=</span> e.depense.mean(), e.depense.std()    <span class="co"># s : en n - 1</span></span>
<span id="cb23-3"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb23-3" tabindex="-1"></a>se <span class="op">=</span> np.sqrt((<span class="dv">1</span> <span class="op">-</span> n <span class="op">/</span> N) <span class="op">*</span> s<span class="op">**</span><span class="dv">2</span> <span class="op">/</span> n)</span>
<span id="cb23-4"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb23-4" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="bu">print</span>(<span class="bu">round</span>(ybar, <span class="dv">2</span>), <span class="bu">round</span>(se, <span class="dv">2</span>), N <span class="op">*</span> ybar, <span class="bu">round</span>(N <span class="op">*</span> se))</span>
<span id="cb23-5"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb23-5" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="bu">print</span>(<span class="bu">round</span>(ybar <span class="op">-</span> <span class="fl">1.96</span> <span class="op">*</span> se, <span class="dv">1</span>), <span class="bu">round</span>(ybar <span class="op">+</span> <span class="fl">1.96</span> <span class="op">*</span> se, <span class="dv">1</span>))</span></code><button class="code-copy-button" title="Copier vers le presse-papier"><i class="bi"></i></button></pre></div>
<pre><code>7843.05 256.87 15686100.0 513736
7339.6 8346.5</code></pre>
</div>
</details>
<details class="examplebox" open="">
<summary class="pedago-title">Avec samplics, qui donne d’office l’intervalle de Student</summary>
<div class="pedago-body">
<div class="sourceCode" id="cb25"><pre class="sourceCode python code-with-copy"><code class="sourceCode python"><span id="cb25-1"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb25-1" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="im">from</span> samplics <span class="im">import</span> TaylorEstimator, PopParam</span>
<span id="cb25-2"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb25-2" tabindex="-1"></a>m <span class="op">=</span> TaylorEstimator(PopParam.mean)</span>
<span id="cb25-3"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb25-3" tabindex="-1"></a>m.estimate(y<span class="op">=</span>e.depense, samp_weight<span class="op">=</span>np.full(n, N <span class="op">/</span> n),</span>
<span id="cb25-4"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb25-4" tabindex="-1"></a>           fpc<span class="op">=</span><span class="dv">1</span> <span class="op">-</span> n <span class="op">/</span> N)                  <span class="co"># samplics : 1 - f</span></span>
<span id="cb25-5"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb25-5" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="bu">print</span>(m)                                   <span class="co"># dernières lignes :</span></span></code><button class="code-copy-button" title="Copier vers le presse-papier"><i class="bi"></i></button></pre></div>
<pre><code>   MEAN         SE         LCI         UCI       CV
7843.05 256.867802 7336.517857 8349.582143 0.032751</code></pre>
</div>
</details>
</section>
</section>
<section class="level1" id="strates-et-grappes-sous-survey">
<h2 class="h1">Strates et grappes sous survey</h2>
<section class="level2" id="déclarer-des-strates">
<h3 class="h2 anchored" data-anchor-id="déclarer-des-strates">Déclarer des strates</h3>
<details class="examplebox" open="">
<summary class="pedago-title">L’échantillon systématique, déclaré stratifié</summary>
<div class="pedago-body">
<div class="sourceCode" id="cb27"><pre class="sourceCode r code-with-copy"><code class="sourceCode r"><span id="cb27-1"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb27-1" tabindex="-1"></a>Nh <span class="ot">&lt;-</span> <span class="fu">table</span>(d<span class="sc">$</span>province)                <span class="co"># 820, 560, 380, 240</span></span>
<span id="cb27-2"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb27-2" tabindex="-1"></a>e9<span class="sc">$</span>Nh <span class="ot">&lt;-</span> <span class="fu">as.numeric</span>(Nh[e9<span class="sc">$</span>province])</span>
<span id="cb27-3"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb27-3" tabindex="-1"></a>ps <span class="ot">&lt;-</span> <span class="fu">svydesign</span>(<span class="at">ids =</span> <span class="sc">~</span><span class="dv">1</span>, <span class="at">strata =</span> <span class="sc">~</span>province,</span>
<span id="cb27-4"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb27-4" tabindex="-1"></a>                <span class="at">fpc =</span> <span class="sc">~</span>Nh, <span class="at">data =</span> e9)</span>
<span id="cb27-5"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb27-5" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">svymean</span>(<span class="sc">~</span>depense, ps, <span class="at">deff =</span> <span class="cn">TRUE</span>)</span>
<span id="cb27-6"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb27-6" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">degf</span>(ps)                               <span class="co"># n - H</span></span>
<span id="cb27-7"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb27-7" tabindex="-1"></a>e9<span class="sc">$</span>N <span class="ot">&lt;-</span> <span class="dv">2000</span>                           <span class="co"># le même, comme un SAS</span></span>
<span id="cb27-8"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb27-8" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">svymean</span>(<span class="sc">~</span>depense, <span class="fu">svydesign</span>(<span class="at">ids =</span> <span class="sc">~</span><span class="dv">1</span>, <span class="at">fpc =</span> <span class="sc">~</span>N, <span class="at">data =</span> e9))</span></code><button class="code-copy-button" title="Copier vers le presse-papier"><i class="bi"></i></button></pre></div>
<pre><code>           mean      SE   DEff
depense 7922.95  260.91 0.9476
[1] 196
        mean     SE
depense 7923 268.02</code></pre>
</div>
</details>
<details class="intuitionbox" open="">
<summary class="pedago-title">Une stratification implicite rendue explicite</summary>
<div class="pedago-body">
<p>Rangé par province, le fichier donne au pas de <span class="math inline">10</span> exactement <span class="math inline">82</span>, <span class="math inline">56</span>, <span class="math inline">38</span> et <span class="math inline">24</span> ménages (chapitre 8). Effet de plan <strong>estimé</strong> : <span class="math inline">0{,}948</span>, pour <span class="math inline">0{,}954</span> en théorie (chapitre 6).</p>
</div>
</details>
</section>
<section class="level2" id="les-strates-en-python">
<h3 class="h2 anchored" data-anchor-id="les-strates-en-python">Les strates en Python</h3>
<details class="examplebox" open="">
<summary class="pedago-title">La formule du chapitre 6, écrite à la main</summary>
<div class="pedago-body">
<div class="sourceCode" id="cb29"><pre class="sourceCode python code-with-copy"><code class="sourceCode python"><span id="cb29-1"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb29-1" tabindex="-1"></a>Nh <span class="op">=</span> d.province.value_counts()             <span class="co"># 820, 560, 380, 240</span></span>
<span id="cb29-2"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb29-2" tabindex="-1"></a>g <span class="op">=</span> e9.groupby(<span class="st">"province"</span>).depense</span>
<span id="cb29-3"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb29-3" tabindex="-1"></a>nh, W <span class="op">=</span> g.size(), Nh <span class="op">/</span> <span class="dv">2000</span></span>
<span id="cb29-4"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb29-4" tabindex="-1"></a>yst <span class="op">=</span> (W <span class="op">*</span> g.mean()).<span class="bu">sum</span>()</span>
<span id="cb29-5"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb29-5" tabindex="-1"></a>V <span class="op">=</span> (W<span class="op">**</span><span class="dv">2</span> <span class="op">*</span> (<span class="dv">1</span> <span class="op">-</span> nh <span class="op">/</span> Nh) <span class="op">*</span> g.var() <span class="op">/</span> nh).<span class="bu">sum</span>()</span>
<span id="cb29-6"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb29-6" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="bu">print</span>(<span class="bu">round</span>(yst, <span class="dv">2</span>), <span class="bu">round</span>(np.sqrt(V), <span class="dv">2</span>))</span></code><button class="code-copy-button" title="Copier vers le presse-papier"><i class="bi"></i></button></pre></div>
<pre><code>7922.95 260.91</code></pre>
</div>
</details>
<details class="definitionbox" open="">
<summary class="pedago-title">Ce que fait chaque ligne</summary>
<div class="pedago-body">
<p><span class="math display">\overline{y}_{st} = \sum_h W_h\,\overline{y}_h \qquad \widehat{V}(\overline{y}_{st}) = \sum_h W_h^2\,(1 - f_h)\,\frac{s_h^2}{n_h}</span> <code>groupby</code> calcule <span class="math inline">n_h</span>, <span class="math inline">\overline{y}_h</span> et <span class="math inline">s_h^2</span> (<code>var()</code> divise par <span class="math inline">n_h - 1</span>) ; <code>pandas</code> aligne les séries sur le nom des provinces. Les degrés de liberté sont <span class="math inline">n - H = 200 - 4 = 196</span> : une moyenne estimée par strate.</p>
</div>
</details>
</section>
<section class="level2" id="cinq-districts-entiers">
<h3 class="h2 anchored" data-anchor-id="cinq-districts-entiers">Cinq districts entiers</h3>
<details class="examplebox" open="">
<summary class="pedago-title">ids nomme les grappes</summary>
<div class="pedago-body">
<div class="sourceCode" id="cb31"><pre class="sourceCode r code-with-copy"><code class="sourceCode r"><span id="cb31-1"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb31-1" tabindex="-1"></a>g5<span class="sc">$</span>NI <span class="ot">&lt;-</span> <span class="dv">50</span>                            <span class="co"># districts de la population</span></span>
<span id="cb31-2"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb31-2" tabindex="-1"></a>pg <span class="ot">&lt;-</span> <span class="fu">svydesign</span>(<span class="at">ids =</span> <span class="sc">~</span>district, <span class="at">fpc =</span> <span class="sc">~</span>NI, <span class="at">data =</span> g5)</span>
<span id="cb31-3"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb31-3" tabindex="-1"></a>m5 <span class="ot">&lt;-</span> <span class="fu">svymean</span>(<span class="sc">~</span>depense, pg, <span class="at">deff =</span> <span class="cn">TRUE</span>)</span>
<span id="cb31-4"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb31-4" tabindex="-1"></a>m5</span>
<span id="cb31-5"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb31-5" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">confint</span>(m5)                            <span class="co"># 1,96 : trop étroit</span></span>
<span id="cb31-6"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb31-6" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">confint</span>(m5, <span class="at">df =</span> <span class="fu">degf</span>(pg))             <span class="co"># Student à 4 ddl</span></span></code><button class="code-copy-button" title="Copier vers le presse-papier"><i class="bi"></i></button></pre></div>
<pre><code>           mean      SE   DEff
depense 8320.93  529.49 4.5622
           2.5 %   97.5 %
depense 7283.152 9358.709
           2.5 %   97.5 %
depense 6850.834 9791.026</code></pre>
</div>
</details>
<details class="intuitionbox" open="">
<summary class="pedago-title">Ce que calcule survey</summary>
<div class="pedago-body">
<p><code>svymean</code> donne le <strong>ratio</strong> du chapitre 9, <span class="math inline">1\,789\,000/215 = 8\,320{,}93</span> dh ; <code>svytotal</code>, l’estimateur de Horvitz-Thompson, <span class="math inline">17\,890\,000</span> dh. <code>degf(pg)</code> vaut <span class="math inline">n_I - 1 = 4</span> : la variance repose sur <strong>cinq</strong> totaux de districts, d’où <span class="math inline">t = 2{,}776</span>.</p>
</div>
</details>
</section>
<section class="level2" id="les-grappes-en-python">
<h3 class="h2 anchored" data-anchor-id="les-grappes-en-python">Les grappes en Python</h3>
<details class="examplebox" open="">
<summary class="pedago-title">Le ratio et ses résidus, district par district</summary>
<div class="pedago-body">
<div class="sourceCode" id="cb33"><pre class="sourceCode python code-with-copy"><code class="sourceCode python"><span id="cb33-1"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb33-1" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="im">from</span> scipy.stats <span class="im">import</span> t</span>
<span id="cb33-2"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb33-2" tabindex="-1"></a>G <span class="op">=</span> g5.groupby(<span class="st">"district"</span>).depense.agg([<span class="st">"size"</span>, <span class="st">"sum"</span>])</span>
<span id="cb33-3"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb33-3" tabindex="-1"></a>r <span class="op">=</span> G[<span class="st">"sum"</span>].<span class="bu">sum</span>() <span class="op">/</span> G[<span class="st">"size"</span>].<span class="bu">sum</span>()       <span class="co"># le ratio</span></span>
<span id="cb33-4"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb33-4" tabindex="-1"></a>res <span class="op">=</span> G[<span class="st">"sum"</span>] <span class="op">-</span> r <span class="op">*</span> G[<span class="st">"size"</span>]             <span class="co"># résidus e_i</span></span>
<span id="cb33-5"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb33-5" tabindex="-1"></a>Nc <span class="op">=</span> <span class="dv">50</span> <span class="op">/</span> <span class="dv">5</span> <span class="op">*</span> G[<span class="st">"size"</span>].<span class="bu">sum</span>()              <span class="co"># N estimé : 2 150</span></span>
<span id="cb33-6"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb33-6" tabindex="-1"></a>se <span class="op">=</span> <span class="dv">50</span> <span class="op">*</span> np.sqrt(<span class="fl">0.9</span> <span class="op">*</span> res.var() <span class="op">/</span> <span class="dv">5</span>) <span class="op">/</span> Nc</span>
<span id="cb33-7"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb33-7" tabindex="-1"></a>q <span class="op">=</span> t.ppf(<span class="fl">0.975</span>, <span class="dv">4</span>)                        <span class="co"># 2,776</span></span>
<span id="cb33-8"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb33-8" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="bu">print</span>(<span class="bu">round</span>(r, <span class="dv">2</span>), <span class="bu">round</span>(se, <span class="dv">2</span>), Nc)</span>
<span id="cb33-9"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb33-9" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="bu">print</span>(<span class="bu">round</span>(r <span class="op">-</span> q <span class="op">*</span> se, <span class="dv">1</span>), <span class="bu">round</span>(r <span class="op">+</span> q <span class="op">*</span> se, <span class="dv">1</span>))</span></code><button class="code-copy-button" title="Copier vers le presse-papier"><i class="bi"></i></button></pre></div>
<pre><code>8320.93 529.49 2150.0
6850.8 9791.0</code></pre>
</div>
</details>
<details class="ecobox" open="">
<summary class="pedago-title">529 dh ici, 569 dh au chapitre 9</summary>
<div class="pedago-body">
<p>Le chapitre 9 divisait par <span class="math inline">n_I\,\overline{M} = 200</span> ménages attendus ; <code>survey</code> divise par le nombre <strong>estimé</strong> <span class="math inline">\widehat{N} = 10 \times 215 = 2\,150</span> : <span class="math inline">569{,}2 \times 200/215 = 529{,}5</span>. Deux linéarisations du même ratio ; la seconde n’exige pas de connaître <span class="math inline">N</span>.</p>
</div>
</details>
</section>
</section>
<section class="level1" id="le-ratio-la-post-stratification-et-le-calage">
<h2 class="h1">Le ratio, la post-stratification et le calage</h2>
<section class="level2" id="lestimateur-par-le-ratio">
<h3 class="h2 anchored" data-anchor-id="lestimateur-par-le-ratio">L’estimateur par le ratio</h3>
<details class="examplebox" open="">
<summary class="pedago-title">svyratio, puis predict</summary>
<div class="pedago-body">
<div class="sourceCode" id="cb35"><pre class="sourceCode r code-with-copy"><code class="sourceCode r"><span id="cb35-1"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb35-1" tabindex="-1"></a>r <span class="ot">&lt;-</span> <span class="fu">svyratio</span>(<span class="sc">~</span>depense, <span class="sc">~</span>taille, p)</span>
<span id="cb35-2"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb35-2" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">c</span>(<span class="fu">coef</span>(r), <span class="fu">SE</span>(r))                      <span class="co"># dépense par personne</span></span>
<span id="cb35-3"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb35-3" tabindex="-1"></a>pr <span class="ot">&lt;-</span> <span class="fu">predict</span>(r, <span class="at">total =</span> <span class="dv">7859</span>)         <span class="co"># X = 7 859 personnes</span></span>
<span id="cb35-4"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb35-4" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">c</span>(pr<span class="sc">$</span>total, pr<span class="sc">$</span>se) <span class="sc">/</span> <span class="dv">2000</span>              <span class="co"># par ménage</span></span></code><button class="code-copy-button" title="Copier vers le presse-papier"><i class="bi"></i></button></pre></div>
<pre><code>depense/taille depense/taille
    2061.24836       53.05089
[1] 8099.6754  208.4635</code></pre>
</div>
</details>
<details class="intuitionbox" open="">
<summary class="pedago-title">Les nombres du chapitre 12</summary>
<div class="pedago-body">
<p><span class="math inline">\widehat{R} = 2\,061{,}25</span> dh par personne, d’erreur-type <span class="math inline">53{,}05</span> ; estimation de la dépense moyenne : <span class="math inline">3{,}9295 \times 2\,061{,}25 = 8\,099{,}68</span> dh. L’erreur-type, <span class="math inline">208{,}46</span>, multiplie celle de <span class="math inline">\widehat{R}</span> par <span class="math inline">\overline{X} = 3{,}9295</span> ; le chapitre 12 la multipliait par <span class="math inline">\overline{x} = 3{,}805</span>, d’où <span class="math inline">201{,}86</span>. Deux approximations, à <span class="math inline">3\,\%</span> l’une de l’autre.</p>
</div>
</details>
</section>
<section class="level2" id="la-post-stratification">
<h3 class="h2 anchored" data-anchor-id="la-post-stratification">La post-stratification</h3>
<details class="examplebox" open="">
<summary class="pedago-title">postStratify et les effectifs connus</summary>
<div class="pedago-body">
<div class="sourceCode" id="cb37"><pre class="sourceCode r code-with-copy"><code class="sourceCode r"><span id="cb37-1"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb37-1" tabindex="-1"></a>pm <span class="ot">&lt;-</span> <span class="fu">data.frame</span>(<span class="at">milieu =</span> <span class="fu">c</span>(<span class="st">"rural"</span>, <span class="st">"urbain"</span>),</span>
<span id="cb37-2"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb37-2" tabindex="-1"></a>                 <span class="at">Freq =</span> <span class="fu">c</span>(<span class="dv">562</span>, <span class="dv">1438</span>))  <span class="co"># effectifs connus</span></span>
<span id="cb37-3"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb37-3" tabindex="-1"></a>pps <span class="ot">&lt;-</span> <span class="fu">postStratify</span>(p, <span class="sc">~</span>milieu, pm)</span>
<span id="cb37-4"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb37-4" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">svymean</span>(<span class="sc">~</span>depense, pps)</span>
<span id="cb37-5"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb37-5" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">unique</span>(<span class="fu">weights</span>(pps))</span></code><button class="code-copy-button" title="Copier vers le presse-papier"><i class="bi"></i></button></pre></div>
<pre><code>          mean     SE
depense 7793.1 252.43
[1]  9.460526 11.708333</code></pre>
</div>
</details>
<details class="intuitionbox" open="">
<summary class="pedago-title">Les poids du chapitre 13</summary>
<div class="pedago-body">
<p>Les poids deviennent <span class="math inline">1\,438/152 = 9{,}461</span> pour les urbains et <span class="math inline">562/48 = 11{,}708</span> pour les ruraux ; l’estimation est celle du chapitre 13, <span class="math inline">7\,793{,}07</span> dh. Le nom des colonnes compte : <code>milieu</code> doit s’écrire comme dans <code>e</code>, et l’effectif s’appeler <code>Freq</code>.</p>
</div>
</details>
</section>
<section class="level2" id="le-calage-linéaire">
<h3 class="h2 anchored" data-anchor-id="le-calage-linéaire">Le calage linéaire</h3>
<details class="examplebox" open="">
<summary class="pedago-title">calibrate sur le nombre de ménages et de personnes</summary>
<div class="pedago-body">
<div class="sourceCode" id="cb39"><pre class="sourceCode r code-with-copy"><code class="sourceCode r"><span id="cb39-1"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb39-1" tabindex="-1"></a>tot <span class="ot">&lt;-</span> <span class="fu">c</span>(<span class="st">`</span><span class="at">(Intercept)</span><span class="st">`</span> <span class="ot">=</span> <span class="dv">2000</span>, <span class="at">taille =</span> <span class="dv">7859</span>)</span>
<span id="cb39-2"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb39-2" tabindex="-1"></a>pc <span class="ot">&lt;-</span> <span class="fu">calibrate</span>(p, <span class="sc">~</span>taille, tot)       <span class="co"># N et X connus</span></span>
<span id="cb39-3"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb39-3" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">svymean</span>(<span class="sc">~</span>depense, pc)</span>
<span id="cb39-4"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb39-4" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">svytotal</span>(<span class="sc">~</span>taille, pc)</span>
<span id="cb39-5"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb39-5" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">range</span>(<span class="fu">weights</span>(pc))</span></code><button class="code-copy-button" title="Copier vers le presse-papier"><i class="bi"></i></button></pre></div>
<pre><code>          mean     SE
depense 8024.7 197.67
       total SE
taille  7859  0
[1]  8.893807 12.443090</code></pre>
</div>
</details>
<details class="intuitionbox" open="">
<summary class="pedago-title">L’estimateur par la régression</summary>
<div class="pedago-body">
<p>La formule <code>~taille</code> contient une constante : on cale sur <span class="math inline">\sum_S w_k = 2\,000</span> <strong>et</strong> <span class="math inline">\sum_S w_k\,x_k = 7\,859</span>. Le total des personnes est reproduit exactement, d’où son erreur-type nulle. Poids de <span class="math inline">8{,}89</span> à <span class="math inline">12{,}44</span> et estimation <span class="math inline">8\,024{,}74</span> dh : ceux du chapitre 13.</p>
</div>
</details>
</section>
<section class="level2" id="le-calage-sur-marges">
<h3 class="h2 anchored" data-anchor-id="le-calage-sur-marges">Le calage sur marges</h3>
<details class="examplebox" open="">
<summary class="pedago-title">rake, milieu et province</summary>
<div class="pedago-body">
<div class="sourceCode" id="cb41"><pre class="sourceCode r code-with-copy"><code class="sourceCode r"><span id="cb41-1"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb41-1" tabindex="-1"></a>pp <span class="ot">&lt;-</span> <span class="fu">data.frame</span>(<span class="at">province =</span> <span class="fu">c</span>(<span class="st">"Tanger-Assilah"</span>, <span class="st">"Tétouan"</span>,</span>
<span id="cb41-2"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb41-2" tabindex="-1"></a>                              <span class="st">"Larache"</span>, <span class="st">"Al Hoceïma"</span>),</span>
<span id="cb41-3"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb41-3" tabindex="-1"></a>                 <span class="at">Freq =</span> <span class="fu">c</span>(<span class="dv">820</span>, <span class="dv">560</span>, <span class="dv">380</span>, <span class="dv">240</span>))</span>
<span id="cb41-4"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb41-4" tabindex="-1"></a>pk <span class="ot">&lt;-</span> <span class="fu">rake</span>(p, <span class="fu">list</span>(<span class="sc">~</span>milieu, <span class="sc">~</span>province), <span class="fu">list</span>(pm, pp))</span>
<span id="cb41-5"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb41-5" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">svymean</span>(<span class="sc">~</span>depense, pk)</span>
<span id="cb41-6"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb41-6" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">range</span>(<span class="fu">weights</span>(pk))</span></code><button class="code-copy-button" title="Copier vers le presse-papier"><i class="bi"></i></button></pre></div>
<pre><code>          mean     SE
depense 7852.1 245.99
[1]  7.484064 15.364057</code></pre>
</div>
</details>
<details class="intuitionbox" open="">
<summary class="pedago-title">L’ajustement proportionnel itératif</summary>
<div class="pedago-body">
<p><code>rake</code> répète les post-stratifications sur chaque marge, comme au chapitre 13 : poids de <span class="math inline">7{,}48</span> à <span class="math inline">15{,}36</span>, estimation <span class="math inline">7\,852{,}1</span> dh. Il s’arrête dès que chaque marge est juste à un ménage près (option <code>epsilon</code>, qui vaut <span class="math inline">1</span>) : <span class="math inline">561{,}93</span> ruraux pour <span class="math inline">562</span>. Une tolérance plus fine donne <span class="math inline">7\,852{,}13</span> dh.</p>
</div>
</details>
</section>
<section class="level2" id="redresser-en-python">
<h3 class="h2 anchored" data-anchor-id="redresser-en-python">Redresser en Python</h3>
<details class="examplebox" open="">
<summary class="pedago-title">Ratio, post-stratification et régression à la main</summary>
<div class="pedago-body">
<div class="sourceCode" id="cb43"><pre class="sourceCode python code-with-copy"><code class="sourceCode python"><span id="cb43-1"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb43-1" tabindex="-1"></a>x, y <span class="op">=</span> e.taille, e.depense</span>
<span id="cb43-2"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb43-2" tabindex="-1"></a>R <span class="op">=</span> y.<span class="bu">sum</span>() <span class="op">/</span> x.<span class="bu">sum</span>()                      <span class="co"># ratio</span></span>
<span id="cb43-3"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb43-3" tabindex="-1"></a>Nm <span class="op">=</span> pd.Series({<span class="st">"rural"</span>: <span class="dv">562</span>, <span class="st">"urbain"</span>: <span class="dv">1438</span>})</span>
<span id="cb43-4"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb43-4" tabindex="-1"></a>post <span class="op">=</span> (Nm <span class="op">/</span> <span class="dv">2000</span> <span class="op">*</span> y.groupby(e.milieu).mean()).<span class="bu">sum</span>()</span>
<span id="cb43-5"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb43-5" tabindex="-1"></a>b <span class="op">=</span> np.cov(x, y)[<span class="dv">0</span>, <span class="dv">1</span>] <span class="op">/</span> x.var()           <span class="co"># pente</span></span>
<span id="cb43-6"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb43-6" tabindex="-1"></a>reg <span class="op">=</span> y.mean() <span class="op">+</span> b <span class="op">*</span> (<span class="dv">7859</span> <span class="op">/</span> <span class="dv">2000</span> <span class="op">-</span> x.mean())</span>
<span id="cb43-7"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb43-7" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="bu">print</span>(<span class="bu">round</span>(R, <span class="dv">2</span>), <span class="bu">round</span>(post, <span class="dv">2</span>), <span class="bu">round</span>(reg, <span class="dv">2</span>))</span></code><button class="code-copy-button" title="Copier vers le presse-papier"><i class="bi"></i></button></pre></div>
<pre><code>2061.25 7793.07 8024.74</code></pre>
</div>
</details>
<details class="definitionbox" open="">
<summary class="pedago-title">Et les poids calés</summary>
<div class="pedago-body">
<p>Le calage linéaire <strong>est</strong> l’estimateur par la régression (chapitre 13) : <code>reg</code> vaut l’estimation de <code>calibrate</code>. Pour obtenir les poids, <code>samplics</code> fournit <code>SampleWeight()</code>, avec les méthodes <code>poststratify</code>, <code>calibrate</code> et <code>rake</code> : son calage sur le milieu et la province donne <span class="math inline">7\,852{,}13</span> dh. La boucle de l’ajustement itératif s’écrit aussi en quelques lignes (feuille d’exercices).</p>
</div>
</details>
</section>
</section>
<section class="level1" id="comparer-les-résultats">
<h2 class="h1">Comparer les résultats</h2>

<details class="ecobox" open="">
<summary class="pedago-title">Ce que montre la figure</summary>
<div class="pedago-body">
<p>Les cinq intervalles, calculés par <code>survey</code> sur le fil rouge, contiennent <span class="math inline">\overline{Y}</span>. Le milieu et la province changent peu l’estimation et sa précision ; la taille du ménage réduit l’erreur-type de <span class="math inline">19</span> à <span class="math inline">23\,\%</span>, mais, sur <strong>cet</strong> échantillon, éloigne l’estimation de <span class="math inline">\overline{Y}</span> (chapitres 12 et 13).</p>
</div>
</details>
</section>

<details class="intuitionbox" open="">
<summary class="pedago-title">Le calage retouche les poids sans les bouleverser</summary>
<div class="pedago-body">
<p>Chaque cercle est un poids, de surface proportionnelle au nombre de ménages qui le portent. Tous les jeux de poids somment à <span class="math inline">N = 2\,000</span>. Le calage linéaire les ordonne selon la taille ; le calage sur marges les écarte le plus (<span class="math inline">7{,}48</span> à <span class="math inline">15{,}36</span>) : il corrige à la fois Larache, sous-représentée, et Al Hoceïma, sur-représentée.</p>
</div>
</details>
</section>
<section class="level2" id="le-logiciel-et-les-formules-du-cours">
<h3 class="h2 anchored" data-anchor-id="le-logiciel-et-les-formules-du-cours">Le logiciel et les formules du cours</h3>
<details class="examplebox" open="">
<summary class="pedago-title">Mêmes estimations, erreurs-types voisines</summary>
<div class="pedago-body">
<table class="caption-top table">
<thead>
<tr class="header">
<th>Erreur-type</th>
<th style="text-align: right;">Cours</th>
<th style="text-align: right;">survey</th>
<th>Écart</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr class="odd">
<td>Ratio (ch. 12)</td>
<td style="text-align: right;"><span class="math inline">201{,}86</span></td>
<td style="text-align: right;"><span class="math inline">208{,}46</span></td>
<td>facteur <span class="math inline">\overline{X}</span></td>
</tr>
<tr class="even">
<td>Post-strat. (ch. 13)</td>
<td style="text-align: right;"><span class="math inline">253{,}1</span></td>
<td style="text-align: right;"><span class="math inline">252{,}43</span></td>
<td>linéarisation</td>
</tr>
<tr class="odd">
<td>Calage (ch. 13)</td>
<td style="text-align: right;"><span class="math inline">189{,}1</span></td>
<td style="text-align: right;"><span class="math inline">197{,}67</span></td>
<td>résidus pondérés</td>
</tr>
<tr class="even">
<td>Grappes (ch. 9)</td>
<td style="text-align: right;"><span class="math inline">569</span></td>
<td style="text-align: right;"><span class="math inline">529{,}49</span></td>
<td><span class="math inline">\widehat{N}</span>, non <span class="math inline">N</span></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
</div>
</details>
<details class="intuitionbox" open="">
<summary class="pedago-title">Plusieurs approximations d’une même variance</summary>
<div class="pedago-body">
<p>Les estimations coïncident au centime. Les erreurs-types diffèrent de <span class="math inline">0{,}3</span> à <span class="math inline">7{,}5\,\%</span> : ce sont des approximations, toutes valables quand <span class="math inline">n</span> est grand, de la variance d’un estimateur non linéaire. Pour le calage, <code>survey</code> multiplie chaque résidu par son poids calé et divise par <span class="math inline">n - 1</span>, non <span class="math inline">n - 2</span>. On indique toujours le logiciel employé.</p>
</div>
</details>
<details class="demonstrationbox">
<summary class="pedago-title">Démonstration : Un seul calcul pour les erreurs-types du logiciel</summary>
<div class="pedago-body">
<p><em>La forme commune.</em> Pour chacun des estimateurs du chapitre, <code>survey</code> calcule l’erreur-type d’une somme <span class="math inline">\sum_{k \in s} z_k</span>, avec <span class="math inline">z_k = w_k\,e_k/N</span> : <span class="math inline">w_k</span> est le poids final du ménage <span class="math inline">k</span>, et <span class="math inline">e_k</span> un résidu qui dépend de l’estimateur : <span class="math inline">y_k</span> pour le sondage simple, <span class="math inline">y_k - \widehat{R}\,x_k</span> pour le ratio, <span class="math inline">y_k - \overline{y}_h</span> pour la post-stratification, <span class="math inline">y_k - a - b\,x_k</span> pour le calage.</p>
<p><em>Le calcul.</em> Posons <span class="math inline">u_k = n\,z_k</span> : la somme <span class="math inline">\sum_k z_k</span> est la moyenne <span class="math inline">\overline{u}</span> des <span class="math inline">u_k</span>. Estimée comme dans un sondage simple, sa variance est <span class="math inline">(1 - f)\,s_u^2/n</span>, et <span class="math inline">s_u^2 = n^2 s_z^2</span> : <span class="math display">\widehat{V} = (1 - f)\,n\,s_z^2 = (1 - f)\,\frac{n}{n - 1}\sum_{k \in s}(z_k - \overline{z})^2.</span> <em>Le sondage simple.</em> Avec <span class="math inline">w_k = N/n</span> et <span class="math inline">e_k = y_k</span>, on a <span class="math inline">z_k = y_k/n</span> et <span class="math inline">\sum_k (z_k - \overline{z})^2 = (n - 1)\,s^2/n^2</span> : on retrouve <span class="math inline">\widehat{V} = (1 - f)\,s^2/n</span>. Pour une variable <span class="math inline">0/1</span>, <span class="math inline">\sum_k y_k^2 = \sum_k y_k = n\,\widehat{p}</span>, donc <span class="math inline">s^2 = \frac{n}{n - 1}\,\widehat{p}\,(1 - \widehat{p})</span> et l’erreur-type d’une proportion est <span class="math inline">\sqrt{(1 - f)\,\widehat{p}\,(1 - \widehat{p})/(n - 1)}</span>. Un total vaut <span class="math inline">N</span> fois la moyenne, comme son erreur-type.</p>
<p><em>Le ratio.</em> Avec <span class="math inline">w_k = \frac{N}{n}\,\frac{\overline{X}}{\overline{x}}</span>, on a <span class="math inline">z_k = \frac{\overline{X}}{\overline{x}}\,\frac{e_k}{n}</span> et <span class="math display">\widehat{V} = \Big(\frac{\overline{X}}{\overline{x}}\Big)^2 (1 - f)\,\frac{s_e^2}{n}.</span> Le chapitre 12 donne <span class="math inline">(1 - f)\,s_e^2/n</span> : la même formule, sans le carré du facteur <span class="math inline">\overline{X}/\overline{x}</span>.</p>
<p><em>La post-stratification.</em> Avec <span class="math inline">w_k = N_h/n_h</span> et <span class="math inline">e_k = y_k - \overline{y}_h</span>, les <span class="math inline">z_k</span> somment à zéro dans chaque strate, et <span class="math display">\widehat{V} = (1 - f)\,\frac{n}{n - 1}\sum_h W_h^2\,\frac{n_h - 1}{n_h^2}\,s_h^2,</span> alors que le chapitre 13 écrit <span class="math inline">\sum_h W_h^2\,(1 - n_h/N_h)\,s_h^2/n_h</span> : le facteur de correction y est compté strate par strate.</p>
<p><em>Le calage.</em> Les poids calés ne sont plus égaux à <span class="math inline">N/n = 10</span> : ils multiplient chaque résidu dans <span class="math inline">z_k</span>, et le diviseur est <span class="math inline">n - 1</span>. Le chapitre 13 garde le poids <span class="math inline">10</span> et divise par <span class="math inline">n - 2</span>.</p>
<p><em>En Python.</em> Le <span class="math inline">n - 1</span> est celui de <span class="math inline">s^2</span> : <code>np.std(y)</code> divise par <span class="math inline">n</span> et donne <span class="math inline">s\sqrt{(n - 1)/n}</span> ; pour les <span class="math inline">2\,000</span> ménages, <span class="math inline">3\,984{,}29\sqrt{1\,999/2\,000} = 3\,983{,}29</span>.</p>
<p><strong>Ce que cela dit.</strong> Sur le fil rouge, la formule redonne les quatre nombres de <code>survey</code> : <span class="math inline">256{,}87</span> pour la moyenne simple ; <span class="math inline">201{,}86 \times 1{,}0327 = 208{,}46</span> pour le ratio (<span class="math inline">\overline{X}/\overline{x} = 3{,}9295/3{,}805</span>) ; <span class="math inline">252{,}43</span> pour la post-stratification, contre <span class="math inline">253{,}1</span> au chapitre 13 ; <span class="math inline">197{,}67</span> pour le calage, dont les poids vont de <span class="math inline">8{,}89</span> à <span class="math inline">12{,}44</span>, contre <span class="math inline">189{,}1</span>. Les écarts avec le cours sont de <span class="math inline">+3{,}3\,\%</span>, <span class="math inline">-0{,}3\,\%</span> et <span class="math inline">+4{,}5\,\%</span> : trois façons voisines d’estimer une même variance. Un total est multiplié par <span class="math inline">N</span> : <span class="math inline">2\,000 \times 256{,}87 = 513\,736</span> ; une proportion de <span class="math inline">0{,}67</span> a pour erreur-type <span class="math inline">\sqrt{0{,}9 \times 0{,}67 \times 0{,}33/199} = 0{,}0316</span>.</p>
<p aria-hidden="true" class="demo-fin">∎</p>
</div>
</details>
</section>
<section class="level2" id="correspondance-entre-r-et-python">
<h3 class="h2 anchored" data-anchor-id="correspondance-entre-r-et-python">Correspondance entre R et Python</h3>
<details class="definitionbox" open="">
<summary class="pedago-title">Les mêmes opérations dans les deux langages</summary>
<div class="pedago-body">
<table class="caption-top table">
<thead>
<tr class="header">
<th>Opération</th>
<th>R</th>
<th>Python</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr class="odd">
<td>Écart-type en <span class="math inline">n - 1</span></td>
<td><code>sd(y)</code></td>
<td><code>y.std()</code>, <code>np.std(y, ddof=1)</code></td>
</tr>
<tr class="even">
<td>Sondage simple</td>
<td><code>sample(N, n)</code></td>
<td><code>rng.choice(N, n, ...)</code></td>
</tr>
<tr class="odd">
<td>Tirage stratifié</td>
<td><code>sampling::strata</code></td>
<td><code>groupby().sample()</code></td>
</tr>
<tr class="even">
<td>Déclarer le plan</td>
<td><code>svydesign()</code></td>
<td>poids et formules</td>
</tr>
<tr class="odd">
<td>Correction <code>fpc</code></td>
<td><span class="math inline">N</span> ou <span class="math inline">f</span></td>
<td>samplics : <span class="math inline">1 - f</span></td>
</tr>
<tr class="even">
<td>Moyenne, total</td>
<td><code>svymean</code>, <code>svytotal</code></td>
<td><code>np.average</code>, <code>sum</code></td>
</tr>
<tr class="odd">
<td>Domaines</td>
<td><code>svyby</code></td>
<td><code>groupby</code>, <code>domain=</code></td>
</tr>
<tr class="even">
<td>Calage</td>
<td><code>calibrate</code>, <code>rake</code></td>
<td><code>SampleWeight()</code></td>
</tr>
<tr class="odd">
<td>Quantile de Student</td>
<td><code>qt(0.975, df)</code></td>
<td><code>t.ppf(0.975, df)</code></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<p>Attention : <code>np.std(y)</code> divise par <span class="math inline">n</span>, comme <span class="math inline">\sigma</span> au chapitre 1 (<span class="math inline">3\,983{,}29</span> au lieu de <span class="math inline">3\,984{,}29</span>).</p>
</div>
</details>
</section>
</section>
<section class="level1" id="les-pièges">
<h2 class="h1">Les pièges</h2>
<section class="level2" id="les-poids-et-la-taille-de-la-population">
<h3 class="h2 anchored" data-anchor-id="les-poids-et-la-taille-de-la-population">Les poids et la taille de la population</h3>
<details class="examplebox" open="">
<summary class="pedago-title">Deux déclarations fausses, sans message d’erreur</summary>
<div class="pedago-body">
<div class="sourceCode" id="cb45"><pre class="sourceCode r code-with-copy"><code class="sourceCode r"><span id="cb45-1"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb45-1" tabindex="-1"></a>e<span class="sc">$</span>pi <span class="ot">&lt;-</span> <span class="fl">0.1</span>; e<span class="sc">$</span>n <span class="ot">&lt;-</span> <span class="dv">200</span></span>
<span id="cb45-2"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb45-2" tabindex="-1"></a>p1 <span class="ot">&lt;-</span> <span class="fu">svydesign</span>(<span class="at">ids =</span> <span class="sc">~</span><span class="dv">1</span>, <span class="at">weights =</span> <span class="sc">~</span>pi, <span class="at">data =</span> e)</span>
<span id="cb45-3"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb45-3" tabindex="-1"></a>p3 <span class="ot">&lt;-</span> <span class="fu">svydesign</span>(<span class="at">ids =</span> <span class="sc">~</span><span class="dv">1</span>, <span class="at">fpc =</span> <span class="sc">~</span>n, <span class="at">data =</span> e)</span>
<span id="cb45-4"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb45-4" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">svytotal</span>(<span class="sc">~</span>depense, p1)                 <span class="co"># poids = pi</span></span>
<span id="cb45-5"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb45-5" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">svymean</span>(<span class="sc">~</span>depense, p3)                  <span class="co"># fpc = n</span></span></code><button class="code-copy-button" title="Copier vers le presse-papier"><i class="bi"></i></button></pre></div>
<pre><code>         total     SE
depense 156861 5415.2
        mean SE
depense 7843  0</code></pre>
</div>
</details>
<details class="ecobox" open="">
<summary class="pedago-title">Lire ce que l’on a déclaré</summary>
<div class="pedago-body">
<ul>
<li><code>weights</code> attend les poids <span class="math inline">d_k = 1/\pi_k</span>, et <code>probs</code> les <span class="math inline">\pi_k</span>. Avec <span class="math inline">\pi_k</span> comme poids, le total est <strong>cent fois</strong> trop petit : <span class="math inline">156\,861</span> dh au lieu de <span class="math inline">15\,686\,100</span>.</li>
<li><code>fpc</code> attend <span class="math inline">N</span>. Avec <span class="math inline">n</span>, <code>survey</code> croit à un recensement (<span class="math inline">f = 1</span>) : erreur-type <strong>nulle</strong>.</li>
</ul>
<p>Les moyennes restent justes : seul un coup d’œil aux totaux et aux erreurs-types révèle l’erreur.</p>
</div>
</details>
</section>
<section class="level2" id="une-variance-estimée-sous-un-mauvais-plan">
<h3 class="h2 anchored" data-anchor-id="une-variance-estimée-sous-un-mauvais-plan">Une variance estimée sous un mauvais plan</h3>
<details class="examplebox" open="">
<summary class="pedago-title">Les cinq districts déclarés comme un SAS de ménages</summary>
<div class="pedago-body">
<div class="sourceCode" id="cb47"><pre class="sourceCode r code-with-copy"><code class="sourceCode r"><span id="cb47-1"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb47-1" tabindex="-1"></a>g5<span class="sc">$</span>N <span class="ot">&lt;-</span> <span class="dv">2000</span>                           <span class="co"># 215 ménages « au hasard »</span></span>
<span id="cb47-2"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb47-2" tabindex="-1"></a>faux <span class="ot">&lt;-</span> <span class="fu">svydesign</span>(<span class="at">ids =</span> <span class="sc">~</span><span class="dv">1</span>, <span class="at">fpc =</span> <span class="sc">~</span>N, <span class="at">data =</span> g5)</span>
<span id="cb47-3"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb47-3" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">svymean</span>(<span class="sc">~</span>depense, faux)</span>
<span id="cb47-4"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb47-4" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">confint</span>(<span class="fu">svymean</span>(<span class="sc">~</span>depense, faux))       <span class="co"># comme un SAS</span></span>
<span id="cb47-5"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb47-5" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">confint</span>(m5, <span class="at">df =</span> <span class="fu">degf</span>(pg))             <span class="co"># comme des grappes</span></span></code><button class="code-copy-button" title="Copier vers le presse-papier"><i class="bi"></i></button></pre></div>
<pre><code>          mean     SE
depense 8320.9 246.86
           2.5 %   97.5 %
depense 7837.093 8804.768
           2.5 %   97.5 %
depense 6850.834 9791.026</code></pre>
</div>
</details>
<details class="ecobox" open="">
<summary class="pedago-title">215 ménages, mais cinq grappes</summary>
<div class="pedago-body">
<p>La même estimation, deux précisions. Déclaré comme un SAS, l’échantillon se croit fait de <span class="math inline">215</span> ménages indépendants : erreur-type <span class="math inline">246{,}86</span>, intervalle qui <strong>manque</strong> <span class="math inline">\overline{Y} = 7\,911{,}44</span>. Les voisins se ressemblent (<span class="math inline">\rho = 0{,}162</span>, chapitre 9) : l’information vient de cinq districts.</p>
</div>
</details>
</section>
